title: Single shift step
statement: For a Boolean list $D$, if the word extracted from its first component is done, return $D$ unchanged. Otherwise, pair its first component with a pair consisting of the remainder of that extracted word and the concatenation of the second component of the inner pair with the shifted encoding of the extracted word.
